How Our Sensor Technology Tracks GHG Emission Reductions and Removals in Real-Time

Each sensor in our projects captures real-time data on greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, allowing us to track emission reductions accurately and in real-time.


We combine this data with satellite imagery to gain a comprehensive view of the environmental situation.Through machine learning algorithms, our platform processes large volumes of data from various regions, optimizing the precision of estimates and ensuring that GHG reductions are reliably.

Blockchain: Transparency and Trust in the Carbon Credit Market

Our system is backed by a unique digital token registered on the blockchain, ensuring that every transaction is fully traceable and verifiable.


Once GHG reductions or removals are verified, Alethia anchors each result to a unique digital asset on the blockchain. This ensures that every tonne of CO₂e is fully traceable from initial measurement to final retirement. The blockchain ledger creates an immutable, tamper‑proof audit trail that eliminates double counting, prevents manipulation, and secures the integrity of climate claims.

The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Improving Accuracy

Alethia’s continuous monitoring generates one of the most detailed greenhouse gas datasets in the industry. But raw atmospheric and spatial measurements are complex, variable, and influenced by environmental noise. This is where artificial intelligence becomes essential.


Our AI models process millions of data points from sensor towers, satellite imagery, and climate variables—detecting subtle patterns, correcting anomalies, and refining outputs to reflect true ecosystem behavior. By continuously learning from field conditions, these models adapt to local variability and enhance precision over time.

Alethia’s Atmospheric‑Based Measurement, Reporting, and Verification Approach

By capturing greenhouse gas exchange directly from the atmosphere, Alethia’s aMRV approach eliminates the uncertainty of models and sampling.


It delivers a continuous, verifiable record of ecosystem performance—aligned with global scientific standards and secured for full transparency. The result is simple but transformative: climate data that can withstand scrutiny, unlock value, and accelerate credible decarbonization at scale.

Alethia turns atmospheric signals into truth. From sensors to satellites, AI to blockchain, every data point is measured, verified, and secured—creating climate intelligence that is continuous, indisputable, and built to withstand the highest scrutiny. This isn’t just monitoring; it’s the new standard for climate accountability.
